scope: All four Cambridge 17 Reading question sets, compared visually with the supplied source scan. This report covers question statements, instructions, answer choices, completion bodies, numbering and word limits. Reading-passage review is recorded separately in cam17-review.json; answer-key review is recorded in keys-report.json. This is a local editorial source-fidelity review, not publisher certification.
